//: Every pill option, in one place. The bar (PillSchema.js, generated at build), the CLI (kinetic bar) and the settings panel all read this file. Order matters: an option's default may depend on options listed before it.

options.label: Style
options.description: Liquid: clear glass with a lit rim. Glass: tinted. Frosted: milky. Solid and outline are flat.

options.label: Shape
options.description: One capsule, or one behind each group of widgets

options.label: Corner radius
options.description: Full makes a capsule

options.label: Length
options.description: How much of the screen one capsule spans

options.label: Alignment
options.description: Where a shorter capsule sits

options.label: Edge gap
options.description: Space between the screen edge and the pill

options.label: End gap
options.description: Space at the pill's two ends

options.label: Window gap
options.description: Extra room between the pill and your windows

options.label: Thickness
options.description: How much thicker the pill is than the widgets

options.label: Island padding
options.description: Room around each island's widgets

options.label: Tint strength
options.description: How much color fills the pill

options.label: Tint
options.description: The bar's theme color, the accent, or any color

options.label: Light
options.description: Sheen, rim light and glint in the liquid and frosted styles

options.label: Border color
options.description: Flat styles only. Auto follows the bar's text

options.label: Glass
options.description: Wallpaper: the live wallpaper bends behind the pill. Blur: Hyprland blurs. Auto uses the wallpaper while it runs

options.label: Refraction
options.description: How far the glass bends the wallpaper at its rim

options.label: Frost
options.description: How much the wallpaper glass blurs

options.label: Dispersion
options.description: Color fringes at the rim, like real glass

options.label: Bevel (px)
options.description: Wallpaper glass: how far in from the rim the glass curves. 0 follows the capsule's thickness

options.label: Edge profile
options.description: Wallpaper glass: under 1 a soft slope, 1 a rounded edge, over 1 a sharp rim with a flat middle

options.label: Saturation
options.description: Wallpaper glass: the color of what shows through

options.label: Brightness
options.description: Wallpaper glass: lighten or darken what shows through

options.label: Rim light
options.description: Wallpaper glass: light catching the curved rim (the bar's own highlight is drawn on top as well)

options.label: Light angle (°)
options.description: Wallpaper glass: where the rim light comes from: 0 the right, 90 the top

options.label: Blur threshold
options.description: Hyprland blur only: fainter pixels are not blurred. Keep it below the tint strength
